For help diagnosing terminal-specific Panel rendering, please ask in [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) and include your terminal emulator. The [Panel docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/panel.rst) describe the title options.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
